title: Audit export: add experiment identifiers, actor details, and change diff summary
author: Kevin Osei
release_notes:
- Audit log export now includes experiment context (experiment_id/variant_id/route_id) for route-level experiments
- Added actor_* fields and change summary to support enterprise SIEM ingestion
- Export schema version bumped to v2 (backward-compatible: v1 still supported behind query param)
description:
Context: Enterprise customers (and internal Security) need exported audit events to be SIEM-ready for Route Experiments. Today our export stream includes event_type + timestamps but is missing experiment identifiers and a human-readable change summary, which makes it hard to answer “who changed what experiment config, when, and from/to what?”.

This PR extends the audit export format (NDJSON) with:
- experiment_id, route_id, and (where applicable) variant_id
- actor fields (actor_id, actor_email, actor_type, impersonated_by) aligned with existing authn payloads
- change_diff_summary: a compact, redacted summary of the config diff for UPDATE events (and lifecycle transitions for START/STOP)

Notes:
- This is export-only; the underlying audit event payload stored in the audit log remains the source of truth.
- PII handling: change_diff_summary is explicitly redacted for known sensitive paths (e.g., header match rules, customer-supplied identifiers). We only include structural/config deltas (allocations, state transitions, thresholds) and stable IDs.
- Versioning: export schema is now versioned. Default remains v1 for one release; v2 can be selected via `schema_version=v2`. Console and SIEM integrations will migrate to v2.

Testing:
- Added golden tests for export rows across CREATE/UPDATE/START/STOP/DELETE
- Added unit tests for redaction rules and diff summarization determinism

Rollout:
- Safe to deploy with schema_version gating; no downstream breakage expected.

Refs:
- ENG-9030 Audit log events for experiment lifecycle
- SUP-24944 Request to export experiment audit events
- Route experiments beta security review feedback (Helio Finance)
commits: audit/export: introduce schema_version routing (v1 default, v2 opt-in)
auth: plumb actor context (id/email/type, impersonation) into audit exporter
audit/diff: add change_diff_summary builder + redaction rules
tests: golden fixtures for route experiment lifecycle exports
docs: update internal SIEM mapping notes and export field reference
conversation:
Marcus Lin (Security) [2025-03-23]: Can you confirm we’re not exporting any user-supplied header values / match expressions? Those can contain PII depending on customer usage.

Kevin Osei (author) [2025-03-23]: Correct. The diff summarizer operates on an allow-list of config paths. For eligibility rules we only export the rule type + presence (e.g., "has_header_rule": true) and stable IDs. Added explicit redaction for `eligibility.header_matches[*].value` and any unknown keys.

Kaitlyn Nguyen (RBAC/Authz) [2025-03-24]: For actor fields, what’s the source of `actor_email`? We should avoid email if the event is service-to-service.

Kevin Osei (author) [2025-03-24]: `actor_email` is only populated for `actor_type=user`. For `actor_type=service` we emit `actor_id` + `actor_service_name` and leave email empty. Added tests for both paths.

Chloe Martin (Console backend) [2025-03-24]: The exporter currently joins experiment context from the stored event payload. Are we guaranteed to emit route_id on update/start/stop? I see create has it.

Kevin Osei (author) [2025-03-24]: Good catch. I updated `audit_event_emitter.ts` to include route_id + variant_ids on lifecycle events consistently. Golden tests include all event types.

Rafael Mendes (SRE/Obs) [2025-03-25]: Any risk of cardinality/cost blowups in downstream storage with change_diff_summary? Some diffs could be big.

Kevin Osei (author) [2025-03-25]: Summary is capped (2KB) and normalized. Large diffs collapse into counts (e.g., "eligibility_rules_changed": 12) and omit raw arrays. Exporter enforces truncation with `… (truncated)` marker.

Marcus Lin [2025-03-25]: Please add one more explicit assertion that unknown fields in the event payload do not leak into the summary.

Kevin Osei (author) [2025-03-25]: Added `diff_summary_unknown_fields_redacted` test; summary builder rejects non allow-listed paths.
